Prep time: 10 minutes Cook time: 20 minutes Total time: 30 minutes Number of Servings: 3 Ingredients 2 cups grated cauliflower (about half a medium head) 1 egg 3 Tablespoons flour 1/4 cup cheddar cheese, grated 1/4 teaspoon salt Directions Preheat oven to 400 °F. Spray a baking sheet or line with parchment paper or foil. Grate cauliflower on large holes of a grater. In a medium bowl, combine cauliflower, egg, flour, cheese, and salt; mix well. Press mixture together to make about 15 small balls or logs; Place on the baking sheet with space between each ball or log. Bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through. For extra crispy tots, broil for an extra 2 minutes. Watch closely to avoid burning. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours. Notes: Texture will be best when freshly made.
